name: mail-tracker
description: Mail Tracker monorepo: React Native client + Node API (see README).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix packages/shared && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix packages/shared && npm run lint --prefix apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/shared && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api
